      "quotes": [
        "In July, updated data from the RAMP 201 Japan study were presented at the",
        "Annual Meeting of the Japanese Society of Gynecologic Oncology (JSGO) held July 17-19, 2026, in Sapporo, Japan. As of May 29, 2026, 16",
        "efficacy-evaluable patients with recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer (LGSOC) had received avutometinib plus defactinib, with a median",
        "follow up of 12.4 months. The combination achieved a 44% overall response rate and a 94% disease control rate across all patients. Response",
        "rates were 71% in patients with KRAS-mutated tumors and 22% in those with KRAS wild-type tumors, with disease control rates of 100% and",
        "89%, respectively."
